comments.author: @Beyondhorizon-n6t
comments.text: That segment on the Babuyan channel crossing gave me instant flashbacks! Those wooden outriggers look fragile to outsiders, but local carpenters building them by hand from native hardwood is true master craftsmanship. Anyone who hasn't crossed that 40 miles of open water doesn't know what a roller coaster feels like.
